Notes: Dhakal p. 57 prints /byaha/ “marriage” as an example of the initial by- cluster. Turner11920 gives Sanskrit vivāhá, Prakrit viāha, Maithili biāh, Bihari biyāh and Hindi byāh “marriage”; the Darai byah- form matches this broad Indo-Aryan continuation. Darai pp. 57, 66, 69; source PDF and full CDIAL reviewed; no rebuild

Dhakal p. 66 prints /bəḍkə/ “big.” Turner11225 gives Prakrit vaḍḍa “big” and Old Awadhi baṛkā “big”; the installed Turner-derived 11225-2 is specifically the inferred -kk- extension of vaḍra corresponding to the Darai -ḍk- adjectival stem. Darai pp. 57, 66, 69; source PDF and full CDIAL reviewed; no rebuild

Dhakal p. 69 prints /pəhele/ “first.” Turner8652 section 2 gives Prakrit pahilla-, Kumaoni pailo, Nepali pailo, Oriya pahila and Hindi pahilā “first”; the Darai pəhel- form matches this -ll- branch rather than section 1 *prathila. Darai pp. 57, 66, 69; source PDF and full CDIAL reviewed; no rebuild
